_comment: Authorization policy (18012-3 11.2.4). Read-only in the gateway: the
standard marks these tables memoryType 'sp' (Secret Programmed) -- secret,
preset, and not changeable over HES-CLME. Edit this file and restart.
In this variant the KID is the active user (st=au) and the parent is not,
so the kid may drive the light power (target A) but not the brightness
(target B) -- the 'kid partial control' case of Annex D.
The credentials below are demo secrets. Never log or expose credInfo.
